description:
.NET Developer 
 

 On behalf of our client, Procom Services is searching for a .NET Developer for a contract opportunity in Hillsboro, Oregon. 
 

 .NET Developer Job Details 
 

 We are looking for a .NET Developer to work in our Rewrite Download Center, a customer facing web-site where customers go to query for and download files to support products. Intent is to primarily ensure compliance to current standards and enable transition to localized dataset to shared enterprise dataset. Developers will be involved in reviewing current state design and working with the technical lead to define future state design, document, review, develop, test, and implement product. 
  
 The SQL developer should be experienced and proficient with transact-sql queries, stored procedures, functions, relational database modeling, Microsoft SQL Enterprise Manager, VS 2008 Biz Intelligence Development Studio, SSIS packages. The .NET Developer should be experienced and proficient with Microsoft Visual Studio (up to versions 2010/2012 required, with knowledge of prior versions a plus) 
 
 
 .NET Developer Mandatory Skills 
 

  SQL proficiency
 .NET 3.5/4.5
 Java 
 Live Content, DITA, SOAP Architecture 
 

 DESIRED: 
 C# 
 Ajax, HTML 5, jQuery, Web application development, Testing and deployment
 

 .NET Developer Start Date 
 

 ASAP
 

 .NET Developer Assignment Length 
 

 4+ Months
 

 "Please note that we are not able to work with candidates on H1B Visas or candidates represented by third parties." 


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Please send your resume in Word format only.
